name: Las Vegas Street Circuit
summary: layout, length, direction and elevation match; start line 92 m off; overhead structures and flat street corners are the visible differences

layout.gameLayout: Las Vegas Strip Circuit 2023-present (17 corners), the layout of every Las Vegas GP 2023-2025
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Las_Vegas_Strip_Circuit (6.201 km, counterclockwise, 17 corners)

layout.note: street circuit: 85 % of the line was compared with OSM road ways (dual carriageways: the deviation includes half the carriageway separation); max 13.7 m at s 5042 (Turn 14, the left from the Strip onto Harmon Avenue)

direction.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Las_Vegas_Strip_Circuit: "street circuit runs counterclockwise"; OSM oneway raceway ways agree

elevation.gameSource: USGS 3DEP via EPQS along the dataset centreline, DTM filters

famousFeatures.real: lidar: gentle fall to the south, total range 16.4 m over the lap, steepest 50 m grade -4.6 % (s 6093, the approach to the pit straight)

banking.method: lidar heights at +-4 m across the OSM centreline every 10 m; tilt = atan((hLeft - hRight) / 8 m)

findings.real: OSM node 13016217986 raceway=start is 91.8 m before the game's line and node 13016217985 raceway=finish 183.5 m before it; the FIA circuit map marks a separate "Start Line" and "Control Line"
findings.proposedFix: START_AT['us-2023'] = [36.1092838, -115.1618816] (the start line; the finish / control line is a further 92 m back at [36.1086649, -115.1625601] - the game has one line)
sources: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/13016217986
https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/13016217985
FIA 2025 Las Vegas GP Event Notes - Circuit Map v2 (legend "Control Line", "Start Line")

findings.game: one deck over the track: the scenery's man_made=bridge polygon at s 4264.4 m (Las Vegas Boulevard Overpass footbridge)
findings.real: the lap passes under the Las Vegas Monorail viaduct twice (OSM ways 43875943 / 395310512, layer 2: s 2110.5, 2381.1, 5552.5, 5556.2 m) and under 7 pedestrian bridges (s 2405.4, 2987.7, 3385.8, 4268.4, 4390.7, 4944.3, 5123 m; only the one at s ~4268 is drawn), most of them over the Strip
findings.proposedFix: add the monorail viaduct crossings (s ~2110-2381 and ~5552-5556) and the footbridge decks; they are linear OSM ways (railway=monorail bridge=viaduct, highway=footway bridge=yes) that build-scenery.mjs does not turn into decks today

findings.game: curvature-derived banking at every slow corner: s 5002-5042 L R16 m (South Las Vegas Boulevard): real -1.2 deg, game 4.4 (max 5.6); s 3061-3091 L R18 m (South Las Vegas Boulevard): real 0 deg, game 5.4 (max 5.5); s 5052-5082 R R32 m (East Harmon Avenue): real -0.4 deg, game 4.2 (max 4.9); s 2061-2131 L R24 m (Sands Avenue): real 0.5 deg, game 4.8 (max 5.6)
findings.real: lidar: city streets, flat (|cross-slope| <= 2.2 deg at 18 of 18 corners, straights 1 deg); no banking is published
findings.proposedFix: no derived banking on this street circuit (per-track factor 0 in js/track.js, or the measured cross-slope profile)
